column1: # OWASP ZAP rules for the baseline scan of cockpit-todo-server (zap-baseline.py -c).
# Format: <id>\t<IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL|OUTOFSCOPE>\t<name>. Lines starting with # are comments.
# The scan runs with -I: WARN only shows in the report; FAIL fails the job. Unlisted rules are WARN.
# Every WARN line says why just above it.
# Headers and cookies the Go suite (hardening_test.go, authn_test.go) already guarantees.
